question: Who has been appointed Chairman of the Economic Advisory Council to the Prime Minister (EAC-PM)? (June 2025)
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**S. Mahendra Dev**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• S Mahendra Dev Appointed New Chief of EAC-PM.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**S. Mahendra Dev** has been appointed as **Chairman of the Economic Advisory Council to the Prime Minister (EAC-PM)**.

 
 
• 
 
He **resigned** as **independent director of Axis Bank** after this appointment.

 
 
• 
 
**Suman Bery**, Vice-Chairman of **NITI Aayog**, currently **heads EAC-PM**.

 
 
• 
 
Dev is an **expert in agriculture and rural economy**.

 
 
• 
 
He is **editor** of *Economic and Political Weekly* and **chairs** the **Institute for Development Studies**, Andhra Pradesh.

 
 
• 
 
Former **Director of Indira Gandhi Institute of Development Research (IGIDR)**.

 
 
• 
 
Holds a **PhD from Delhi School of Economics** and did **post-doc at Yale University**.

 
 
• 
 
**EAC-PM** is an **independent body** that **advises the PM on economic and policy issues**.

 
 
• 
 
Functions include: **analyzing macroeconomic issues**, **providing advice**, and **undertaking tasks** referred by the PM.
